title: Valid gate lists
statement: A list of gates is valid relative to a current length $L$ if, for each gate in order, its argument list has at most two distinct indices, a NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every argument index is less than the current length; after each gate, the current length increases by one. The empty list is valid for every $L$.
